high_level_overview.overview: This JCL job, named **DALYREJS**, is designed to define a Generation Data Group (GDG) in the system's catalog for storing daily rejection records related to the CardDemo credit card application. It uses the IDCAMS utility to create a GDG base entry named **AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.DALYREJS** with a retention limit of 5 generations, meaning only the 5 most recent datasets will be kept, with older ones automatically scratched (deleted). This is a one-time setup job that establishes the GDG infrastructure needed to manage and track daily transaction rejection files in a controlled, versioned manner.

parameters.name: JOB
parameters.description: The JOB statement marks the beginning of a job and assigns the job name 'DALYREJS', which uniquely identifies this job to the system.

parameters.name: ACCOUNTING INFORMATION
parameters.description: The first positional parameter on the JOB statement providing accounting information. It is used for job accounting and billing purposes, describing the job as defining a GDG for REJS.

parameters.name: CLASS
parameters.description: Specifies the job class 'A', which determines the job entry subsystem (JES) input queue where the job is placed. It controls scheduling priority and resource allocation based on installation-defined class definitions.

parameters.name: MSGCLASS
parameters.description: Specifies the output class '0' for the job log and system messages. This determines where the job's JES message output (job log) is routed, such as to a printer, spool, or held queue, as defined by the installation.

parameters.name: NOTIFY
parameters.description: Specifies that the user whose user ID is stored in the symbolic parameter &SYSUID (the submitting user) will receive a TSO notification message when the job completes, informing them of the job's completion status.

job_details.purpose: Defines a Generation Data Group (GDG) named AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.DALYREJS with a limit of 5 generations and the SCRATCH option, which automatically deletes the oldest generation dataset when the limit is exceeded.
job_details.outputs: GDG base entry AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.DALYREJS defined in the catalog; SYSPRINT (command execution report)

data_operations.description: Defines a Generation Data Group (GDG) named AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.DALYREJS with a LIMIT of 5 generations and SCRATCH option, using IDCAMS utility
